fieldValues.title: The schema-sync poll workflow could not open its own pull request
fieldValues.summary: Follow-through on the srs to srs-rust schema-sync automation: the poll workflow ran green, detected the release and pushed its branch, but could not open the pull request. GitHub Actions lacked repository permission to create pull requests - a repository setting, not a workflow permissions block.
fieldValues.body: The automation landed in srs#615 and srs-rust#962 as a scheduled poll of the srs release feed rather than a repository_dispatch, so no cross-repo credential is needed. The first scheduled run pushed its branch and then failed at pull request creation. The cause is the repository-level Actions setting allowing GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests, which is off by default and cannot be granted from the workflow file: declaring pull-requests write permission in the workflow is necessary and not sufficient. The master thread enabled the setting; the first real poll pull request is https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/968, which srs-rust#969 is in turn blocked on for its Schema Drift check.
